project_title: Illuminate Your Diwali – Premium Indian Home Decor & Gifting E-commerce

core_principles: Tactile Warmth & Refined Heritage: Warm saffron, champagne gold, ivory canvas, and rich charcoal text with subtle terracotta touches.
Editorial Direct-to-Consumer Aesthetic: Avoid marketplace clutter, aggressive countdown timers, or cheap sale badges. Maintain generous spacing, refined product cards, and curated storytelling.
Shopify-Liquid Compatibility: Clean component boundaries (Sections, Snippets, Data Schemas) with centralized theme tokens for seamless Liquid porting.
Mobile-First & Tactile UX: Micro-interactions tuned for mobile thumb zones (sticky CTA bar, swipeable galleries, slide-over filter drawer, instant cart drawer).

rules: Use #FFF9F0 (Ivory) for page background and section contrasts, keeping #FFFFFF for product cards and modal containers.
Primary CTAs use #E89124 (Saffron) with #FFFFFF text and subtle #B96516 hover depth.
Never use generic blue (#1B93A4 or #7351B7) or harsh full-black (#000000). Use #29251F for deep charcoal text.
Ensure all text against ivory and white meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio.

rules: Headings MUST use Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond serif fonts.
Do NOT use Inter for main headings or section titles.
Maintain tight letter spacing for headings (tracking-tight) and wide tracking for eyebrow tags.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-cart-btn', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='filter-price-slider', data-testid='pincode-check-input').
testing_and_accessibility.mobile_touch_targets: Minimum touch area 44px x 44px for buttons and form controls on mobile.
testing_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Support prefers-reduced-motion CSS query to pause non-essential carousel or scroll animations.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow mobile-first responsive design across all 320px–1600px test viewports.
Do NOT use placeholder images or fake broken links. Use provided Unsplash/Pexels image URLs.
Do NOT center align page root containers or rely on generic blue accents.
Ensure every button, link, search input, filter toggle, accordion, and modal contains a unique kebab-case data-testid.
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor icons exclusively, avoiding AI emoji characters.
